comment: Castle rooftops (docs/regioes/topo-do-castelo.md), the pilot of the tools plan: Hyrule Castle seed 3 has two exits, the main one to the rooftops (stairs up) and the extra one to the basement (NextPool [[CastleBasement, 2], [CastleTop, 1]]). Link takes the main exit and comes to the rooftops, where it rains and thunders (log line weather level=14) and most rooms are painted rooms of the set CastleTop; he takes the rooftops' exit to the Castle Prison. Then a new build of the castle seed 3 and the extra exit, to the basement.
